payload.title: File:Velocisaurus Skeletal.png
payload.description_html:
Skeletal reconstruction of Velocisaurus unicus, a cursorial noasaurine from the Late Cretaceous Bajo de la Carpa Formation of Argentina. Based on the holotype MUCPv-41, a partial right leg, and the referred specimen MPCN-PV-370, a partial left leg. Unknown material filled in using Masiakasaurus. Total length is approximately 1.3 m through the centra.
References: José F. Bonaparte, 1991 and Egli et. al., 2016.
